data.name: Heavy Spoilers RPG 2: Your best friend is actually the great demon king
data.detailed_description:
The smash-hit series with over 25 million views online returns!

Heavy Spoilers RPG 2: Your best friend is actually the great demon king is now available on Steam!

Even though the names and dialogue of the characters' blatantly spoil what is going to happen, the story will still manage to move you to tears.

WHAT MAKES THIS GAME SPECIAL?

This is the second entry in the story-focused "Heavy Spoilers RPG" series.
(Do not worry if you have not played the first game. There is no story connection.)

At the heart of the tale is a swordsman who has lost his memory, and his best friend who is hiding a dark secret—he is in fact the "Demon King"!

Knowing the story ahead of time is not enough to soften the blows, and every conversation, and every choice hits harder because of that.
You will find yourself tearing up despite knowing exactly what is going to come next—
an all-new RPG experience where you can't stop playing, even though there are nothing but spoilers.

STORY

Demons have been attacking villages near a certain forest, which has left the kingdom shaken.

Even the king himself fears for his life, as rumors spread that the Demon King has shapeshifted into human form. Distrust and paranoia engulf the royal court.

Meanwhile, in the forest, a swordsman awakens with no memory of who he is.

As he embarks on a quest to regain his memories, he forges bonds of friendship with the people he meets along the way.

However, none of them are prepared for the choices that await them. Choices that will unmask deception, test loyalties, and reveal shocking truths.

One question will remain—what is the true identity of his best friend?

A tale of conflict, betrayal, and revelation unravel around you as you journey deeper and deeper into the heart of the story!

GAME SYSTEM

Experience classic turn-based battles using a command selection system.
Level up your characters, learn new skills, and explore towns and dungeons across the land as the story unfolds.

Choose between two difficulty settings — Normal and Story — to match your preferred playstyle.
While normal mode allows you to enjoy the riveting RPG combat, story mode is perfect for those who just want to enjoy the story and not worry to much about leveling up or item management.
Additional content becomes available after clearing the main story.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS

Z key: Confirm (Confirm / Talk / Examine)
X key: Cancel / Menu (Open or close the menu / Cancel an action)
Arrow keys: Move (Move your character / Move the cursor)

Other Information

  • Estimated Play Time

    • Normal Mode: Around 15 hours

    • Story Mode: Around 10 hours

data.short_description: Demons are in the forest and King Beek Eld fears for his life. His allies Kil Yu and Cleer Leeahspy are with him as rumors spread. The Demon King may be hiding as a human. Elsewhere, a man awakens with amnesia. He manages to make a best friend but doesn't yet know the shocking truth of his identity.
